svg.text: t=0: run-report.parent_start_ns = 1131206029188286 ns (same-host monotonic); one saved run
Gaps stay gaps. CPU is interval-average core (1 core = 100%); not remote model CPU or exclusive tool cost.
Network: up to 3 complete-window non-lo interfaces ranked by rx+tx; display rule, NOT identified API egress. Never sum interfaces.
Source: series/20261017T025315Z-22-r1-assistant.csv (source file + locator + raw monotonic endpoints); unit=core; no smoothing/interpolated missing points.

Source: series/20261017T025315Z-22-r1-assistant.csv (source file + locator + raw monotonic endpoints); unit=MiB; no smoothing/interpolated missing points.

Source: series/20261017T025315Z-22-r1-assistant.csv (source file + locator + raw monotonic endpoints); unit=MiB/s; no smoothing/interpolated missing points.
Source: series/20261017T025315Z-22-r1-assistant.csv (source file + locator + raw monotonic endpoints); unit=MiB/s; no smoothing/interpolated missing points.
Disk/proc counters are not complete filesystem I/O. Shared netns includes background traffic and virtual-interface duplicate observations.
Directory scans may contribute CPU/I/O inside these windows. Kernel memory peak is not a current/RSS curve; scope peaks are never added.
